question: Identify the Headquarters of the East Coast Railway Zone of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bhubaneswar** is the headquarters of the East Coast Railway Zone.
 
• The East Coast Railway Zone was formed on **April 1, 2003**.
 
• This railway zone covers the states of **Odisha**, parts of **Chhattisgarh**, and **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• The zone was created to cater to the increasing transport demands and to improve the railway infrastructure in these regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Railways**

 
 
• Indian Railways is one of the world's largest railway networks, operating under the Ministry of Railways.
 
• It is divided into 18 zones, each headed by a General Manager.
 
• Indian Railways plays a crucial role in the transportation infrastructure of India, providing both passenger and freight services.
 
 
 
• **Zones and Divisions**
 
 
• Each railway zone is further divided into divisions, which are headed by Divisional Railway Managers (DRMs).
 
• The East Coast Railway Zone comprises three divisions: Khurda Road, Waltair, and Sambalpur.
 
 
 
• **Railway Budget**
 
 
• Until 2017, the Railway Budget was presented separately from the Union Budget. Since then, it has been merged with the Union Budget.
 
• This change aimed to streamline the budgeting process and ensure better allocation of resources.
